snippet.title: nanos world - Closed Alpha Announcement Teaser | Sign Up Now!
snippet.description:
https://nanos-world.com
JOIN OUR DISCORD TO BECOME A TESTER https://discord.nanos-world.com

nanos world is the next-generation open-world multiplayer sandbox. Play community-made game modes, create addons with Lua scripting, import custom assets from Unreal Engine 5, and host your own dedicated servers for hundreds of players! 

WISHLIST NOW https://store.steampowered.com/app/1841660/nanos_world

FOLLOW US ON X https://x.com/nanos_world
CHECK THE DOCS https://docs.nanos-world.com
